text:
Maya: hi folks, new hire here. On Windows 11 with the corp VPN client (WireGuard wrapper). I can RDP to the bastion but when I try to pull docker images from internal registry registry.internal:5000 it just times out. Anyone seen registry access issues from new laptops?
Evan: welcome Maya. Quick check: can you curl the registry from the bastion?
Maya: on bastion `curl -v http://registry.internal:5000/v2/_catalog` returns the catalog. From my laptop it times out.
Luis: likely split-tunnel + missing internal DNS. Windows client also needs the DNS suffix pushed for internal domains.
Maya: how do I check DNS suffix?
Evan: run `ipconfig /all` while connected and look for DNS Suffix Search List and the VPN adapter DNS servers.
Maya: output shows only my home router DNS and no search suffix.
Luis: ok. Quick workaround: SSH tunnel from your laptop to the bastion forwarding the registry port. Example: `ssh -L 5001:registry.internal:5000 maya@bastion.company` then point docker to localhost:5001. On Windows run that from PowerShell (or use putty plink).
Maya: tried that and `docker pull localhost:5001/myorg/image:latest` works over the tunnel. Unblocked for now.
Evan: i'll open a ticket to push the registry route and DNS suffix to the onboarding WireGuard profile and request security review for exposing resolver to remote endpoints. infra-bot?
infra-bot: Created INFRA-5120: "onboarding-WG: push internal DNS suffix + registry route" assigned to @Evan. SLA: 48h.
Maya: thanks! also noticed SAML reauth sometimes restarts the VPN client and drops routes mid-session, causing the tunnel to disappear. Is that normal?
Luis: yes, SAML reauth can restart the client. If that happens reconnect, or use the SSH tunnel as fallback until INFRA-5120 lands. We'll note reauth behavior in the ticket.
Maya: perfect — appreciate the help and the warm welcome :smile:
Evan: welcome aboard, ping here if the ticket stalls.
